company.name: Bankjoy
company.shortDescription: Bankjoy is a Y Combinator and Bessemer Venture Partner backed FinTech startup.
company.description: Detroit-based FinTech, Bankjoy, delivers modern banking technology, including mobile banking, online banking, e-statements, online account opening, loan applications, and AI-powered voice banking to credit unions — big and small. The company prides itself on creating beautiful products with advanced features, simple navigation, modern look and feel, and world-class user experiences shaped by talking to users.  Its banking API is a proven bridge between financial institutions and the world’s most cutting edge FinTech.  Bankjoy is a Y Combinator-backed company.
